name: ESQUE80
author: Lichthaus
summary: An 8-voice cross-wave synthesizer modelled on the Ensoniq SQ-80: three wavetable oscillators per voice, a 4-pole low-pass filter, four envelopes with touch-editable displays, three LFOs and a 15-source mod matrix, on an eleven-page skin with Q-Link banks per panel. Plays on built-in stand-in waves; add your own wave ROM for the original sound.
